class.name: big_bertha_controllers/JointEffortPdController
class.description: Synchronous joint-space effort-PD controller. Reads position/velocity state with zero latency in the controller_manager update and applies tau = Kp*(q_des - q) + Kd*(0 - qd), torque-limited, emulating the Isaac Lab implicit actuator the gait policy was trained against. Position targets arrive on ~/commands (std_msgs/Float64MultiArray).
